entries.title: Zephaniah 3:1
segments: ¶Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city! {her...: or, gluttonous: Heb. craw}

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:2
segments: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the LORD; she drew not near to her God. {correction: or, instruction}

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:3
segments: Her princes within her [are] roaring lions; her judges [are] evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:4
segments: Her prophets [are] light [and] treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:5
segments: The just LORD [is] in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame. {every...: Heb. morning by morning}

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:6
segments: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant. {towers: or, corners}

words.text: , so that there is no man

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:7
segments: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, [and] corrupted all their doings.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:8
segments: ¶Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the LORD, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination [is] to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, [even] all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:9
segments: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent. {language: Heb. lip} {consent: Heb. shoulder}

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:10
segments: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, [even] the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:11
segments: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain. {because...: Heb. in my holy}

words.text: against me: for then I will take away

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:12
segments: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the LORD.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:13
segments: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make [them] afraid.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:14
segments: ¶Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:15
segments: The LORD hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, [even] the LORD, [is] in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.

words.text: of thee: thou shalt not see

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:16
segments: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: [and to] Zion, Let not thine hands be slack. {slack: or, faint}

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:17
segments: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee [is] mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing. {rest: Heb. be silent}

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:18
segments: I will gather [them that are] sorrowful for the solemn assembly, [who] are of thee, [to whom] the reproach of it [was] a burden. {reproach...: Heb. the burden upon it was reproach}

words.text: , [who] are of thee, [to whom] the reproach
. {reproach...: Heb. the burden upon it was reproach}

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:19
segments: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame. {get...: Heb. set them for a praise} {where...: Heb. of their shame}

words.text: where they have been put to shame
. {get...: Heb. set them for a praise} {where...: Heb. of their shame}

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:20
segments: At that time will I bring you [again], even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the LORD.
